headline: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged Chinese spy
summary: Nvidia opened a board investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, reportedly recruited by Chinese intelligence. Huang admitted to an affair with her in a staff memo. He was summoned before a congressional committee, Nvidia's stock fell, and commentators debated the national-security fallout and whether Huang could lose his job, while Trump and Elon Musk voiced public support for him.
